title: rollout-report template variables
description: Values for templates/rollout-report.md.j2 and templates/rollout-report.html.j2. Generated by tpl-jinja from rollout-report.md; `description` on each property is the question put to the author.

site_id.title: Site id
site_id.description: Which call site is this rollout on? One site per report - a swap judged across two sites hides a regression on the quieter one.

window_end.title: Window end
window_end.description: When does the measurement window end?

window_start.title: Window start
window_start.description: When does the measurement window start? It must cover at least 48 hours and must not span a deploy, or the two arms are not comparable.
